open_points.subject: A8 rejection of a port below the valid range
open_points.text:
| A8 | reading each run setting, its default, and the refusal of a missing required setting or of a value of the wrong form | `runtime_settings` |
| A8 | the refusal of a well-formed port above 65535 and of a time zone the database does not know | `deliverer_service` |
open_points.question: Which module owns refusal of a well-formed integer port below 1, such as 0 or -1?
options: `runtime_settings` treats a below-range integer as a value of the wrong form
`deliverer_service` owns both lower- and upper-bound validation
another module owns the lower-bound check
open_points.default_guess: `deliverer_service` owns both bounds because they are semantic range checks on a successfully parsed integer.

witness.initial: All required settings are present and valid except `PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT`, whose value is `0`.
events: `runtime_settings` reads and parses the environment value as an integer.
`deliverer_service` receives the resulting settings during startup.
outcomes: `runtime_settings` refuses `0` as being of the wrong form and never returns settings.
`runtime_settings` returns settings containing port 0, and `deliverer_service` refuses it as a range error.
witness.observer: Module-level startup tests and maintainers deciding where the validation and failure type belong.

open_points.subject: exception types and the dependency used by `deliverer_router`
open_points.text: - no exception type: those belong to `refusals` and `deliverer_api`.
open_points.question: Which exact exception types does `refusals` own and which does `deliverer_api` own, especially `AuthenticationRequired`, so that consumers know the authoritative provider?
options: `refusals` owns the refusal exception types and `deliverer_api` owns `AuthenticationRequired`
`refusals` owns `AuthenticationRequired` and `deliverer_api` only raises or handles it
the two modules share ownership of exception types
open_points.default_guess: `refusals` owns the refusal exception types, while `deliverer_api` owns `AuthenticationRequired`.
